reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 14 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA and native note/right-edge crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and evidence, and unchanged naiwa.png; checked hair, thick brows, clean-shaven face, no glasses, one mouth, three-quarter presentation, high collar/diamond tab without tie, collar fit, backplate, note footprint and edge tab.

remaining_reasons: The returned native note adds a separate gray blob below the left side of the second main mark row, outside the original compact upper marking footprint. The enlarged original has no such independent lower-left blob. Remove the added mark and restore only the source's existing faint mark groups and original blank areas.

The original small dark right-edge note tab is replaced by a triangular paper notch/fold in the native return. Restore the source's compact dark tab in its original position and form rather than substituting a torn notch or crease.
entries.positive_observation: Short dark-brown hair swept back and to the side, high forehead, mildly receding temples, short sideburns and thick dark brows remain. The face is clean-shaven with no moustache, beard or glasses and has one severe closed mouth. The three-quarter bust presentation, tight crop and directional facial modeling are retained. The dark gray-green high-collared tunic keeps the clearly visible light-gray diamond-shaped collar tab with a dark center on viewer left and no tie. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk or pinching. The dark gray-green photographic backplate and thin dark frame remain opaque. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, missing backing or working-matte ring; the extra lower-left note blob and tab substitution remain separate visible rejection reasons.
entries.visible_limitations: The internal symbol of the small collar tab and note glyphs cannot be read reliably at 65x67 and are not rejection grounds. The rejection depends on the clearly resolved extra lower-left gray blob and changed native right-edge construction, not on interpreting tiny writing or alpha values.
